run_exec_linter: run the exec linter on a list of files to check for executable permissions
check_file_executable: check if a single file has executable permissions and return a lint message
create_lint_message: create a LintMessage named tuple with path, code, severity, and description fields
use_lint_severity: use the LintSeverity enum to set error, warning, advice, or disabled levels
review_check_file: review the check_file function to understand how it detects executable file permissions
